about: Proposed IDNUnified values for workflow 2.1.0. Apply by hand to .claude/workflow-profile.json on int/api: merge each key under "set" into the profile (an object key replaces only the fields given), append the "provenance" rows, set "updated", then run profile-check.mjs and profile-diff.mjs. Every change here is an Owner item (new commands, a commands.* change), never an auto-applied addition. scripts/heavy-lock.sh, scripts/hotfix-worktree.sh, test-select --merge and deploy-beta.sh --out/--bundle/--when-safe do not exist on int/api 2e0ce72b7: each key goes in once its script lands.

tests.notes: One heavy job per machine: a full run (commands.test_full, sharded), a rehearsal (g6-full, isolation-matrix), flows-all or a selection above quick runs inside heavy_lock, outermost; the heavy_jobs slots stay inside it. A release verification takes it once (owner e.g. hotfix-<name>-release) and runs g6-full and test:full:sharded side by side; the hold exports IDN_HEAVY_LOCK_TOKEN so their own lock calls join it. merge_delta is the test run at every merge (lane -> int, hotfix -> release/beta, the back-merge), {ours} the target head before the merge, {theirs} the head merged in.

release.notes: A hotfix branches off release/beta (docs.release_branch), merges there, deploys, then back-merges into the integration branch: one merge before the deploy. package starts while the release verification runs (the deploy itself is about 2.4 min). deploy needs the owner's approval of that deploy (CLAUDE.md#hard-guardrails); when given up front with the request, {description} carries the owner's words. --when-safe waits for the safe window (never while sync.lock is held).

commands.notes: test_task and test_lane_end run the quick tier (the changed packages' tests, the tests that read their output, the static pins) and never escalate: when the selector asks for more, the lane reports 'escalated, deferred' and runs nothing broader, not vitest related (700+ files, 89 min on 2026-11-26). {base} is the lane's base on the integration branch, or release/beta for a hotfix, never main (a selector without a base diffs against main and selected the full suite). The one wide run is commands.test_full, once per release candidate, under tests.heavy_lock. typecheck is incremental (tsc --build, emits dist); typecheck_clean (tsc --build --force) is for a suspect build info and the cut-end gate. Every test command carries the lane's own TEST_DATABASE_URL on :5437, never :5433 or :5434. cleanup_list is read-only (worktrees, branches, test DBs, ports a batch leaves), run once at batch close. commands.test_full runs through the full_run slot (gates.full-run).

unchanged_on_purpose.known_reds: context/testing/known-reds.md is already the profile's top-level known_reds key; 2.1.0 makes every run subtract it rather than adding a second tests.known_reds key.
unchanged_on_purpose.docs.release_branch: release/beta already names the release branch; {release_branch} is filled from it.
unchanged_on_purpose.gates.gitleaks-staged / typecheck-touche: already staged-diff gitleaks, an incremental tsc --build of the touched references, and staged lint and prettier: the 2.1.0 commit-gate rules hold already.

owner_items_outside_the_profile: scripts/merge-gate.sh runs `test-select --since <since> --tier standard --run`: switch that selection to `--merge <ours> <theirs> --tier quick --max-tier quick` (or drop it for tests.merge_delta), so a merge never runs a broad selection.
scripts/test-select.mjs: add --merge <ours> <theirs>, and make a missing base an error rather than a diff against main.

scripts/heavy-lock.sh: `run --owner <label> -- <cmd>`, exporting IDN_HEAVY_LOCK_TOKEN to the child; a call that carries a live token joins the hold instead of waiting; the waiting message names the holder's label.
context/testing/known-reds.md: the runners (test-select --run, test:full:sharded) should print reds as known/new against it, and list a known file that passed for removal.

provenance.path: tests.heavy_lock, tests.heavy_lock_token, tests.merge_delta, release.*, commands.test_task, commands.test_lane_end
provenance.change: one heavy job per machine through scripts/heavy-lock.sh; the merge delta run; the hotfix path off release/beta with package beside the wide run and deploy --when-safe; quick tier with no escalation in lanes and tasks
